theme.scene: A striped market stall with a red awning shows a basket of tomatoes and a round loaf on its counter, with a glowing paper lantern hanging above and a leafy green tree beside it against a warm yellow wall.

objects.name: bread loaf
objects.draw: a round golden-brown loaf with a cream flour dusting and three darker scored lines on top

objects.name: flower pot
objects.draw: a terracotta orange flowerpot with three pink tulips and green leaves poking out of the top

objects.name: market umbrella
objects.draw: a big striped umbrella with red and cream panels, a scalloped edge, and a brown pole

objects.name: cheese wedge
objects.draw: a yellow wedge of cheese with round holes, an orange rind along the edge and a cream-coloured top

objects.name: paper lantern
objects.draw: a round red paper lantern with gold bands around its middle, a dark cap on top and a tassel of gold fringe underneath

objects.name: market stall
objects.draw: a wooden market stall with a red and white striped awning, a green counter, crates of red apples and orange tomatoes, and a little brown sign post

theme.cast: Two small mice tugging a wedge of cheese across the cobbles toward a loaf of bread.

vistaTries.name: 20261101_vista-dusk-0.jpg
vistaTries.wrong: Compared with the morning painting, the scene has changed: an arched lit window has been added to the wall on the right where the morning painting shows only plain wall and bricks. The dusk version should show the same place with only the light and sky changed.

vistaTries.name: 20261101_vista-dusk-1.jpg
vistaTries.wrong: Not quite the same place as the morning painting: a lit window has appeared on the wall to the right of the stall, where the morning painting shows only bare wall and bricks.
